tagline: On-demand technical intelligence, anti-bot shield & verified developer network.
radar_desc: Curated releases from your starred repositories and rising projects matching your stack.
sentinel_desc: Heuristic detection of mass-following accounts using account age and follower ratios.
directory_desc: A decentralized Web of Trust featuring genuine open-source creators and tools.
modal_desc: Use your GitHub session. No browser token needed.
refresh_help: Update Feed opens GitHub. Confirm “Run workflow”, then return here.
step_1_body: You can read this feed without signing in. To update it, use a GitHub account with write access to this repository. Create your own copy if needed.
step_2_body: If this page is already live, continue. For a new copy, enable Actions in the repository, then choose GitHub Actions as the Pages source. Run Deploy GitHub Pages once.
step_3_body: Click “Run workflow” on GitHub and confirm the run. Return here: the feed refreshes after the job and publication finish. No token to paste.
waiting_feed: Waiting for a new published feed. Confirm the run in GitHub.
feed_empty: No feed yet. Update it using your GitHub session.
wait_finished: No new feed received in five minutes. Check the run in GitHub or try again.
load_error: Could not load the feed. Check your connection and reload.
setup_error: Deployment details are unavailable. Run Deploy GitHub Pages again.
review_desc: Every follower and account you follow, scored with a trust %. Nothing is blocked automatically: inspect the reasons and decide.
review_scan_help: Queue empty? Run “GitHub Review - Scan and Block” (mode scan) on GitHub, then return here.
review_block_help: Tick suspicious accounts, copy the list, then open the block workflow (mode block) and paste it. Profile links open GitHub where you can block natively.
copied_msg: List copied. Paste it as targets in the workflow form.
review_empty: No review data yet. Run a scan first.
reason_young_mass_follow: Very new account ({d}) with mass following
reason_lonely_hunter: Follows many ({d}) but nobody follows back
